title: Physicist friend sees boulder pushed into a tree at the Roswell site

tellings.quote: I went I went to, you know, the Roswell site and I saw that a boulder had clearly been pushed into a what was probably a sapling at the time.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he visited the Roswell site in New Mexico, where many people believe a craft crashed in 1947. He says he saw a boulder that had clearly been pushed into what was probably a young tree back then. He offers it as a physical trace that, if he is right, would suggest something struck the ground there with force.
